SecuritiesMovementType.name: Securities Movement Type
SecuritiesMovementType.definition: Specifies whether the quantity of financial instrument are to be delivered or received

FinancialInstrumentIdentification.name: Financial Instrument Identification
FinancialInstrumentIdentification.definition: Financial instrument representing a sum of rights of the investor vis-a-vis the issuer.

CollateralMovement.name: Collateral Movement
CollateralMovement.definition: Indicates whether the financial instrument is delivered/received as collateral.

SecuritiesMovementsApproved.name: Securities Movements Approved
SecuritiesMovementsApproved.definition: Indicates whether the proposed securities movements can be accepted.

PositionType.name: Position Type
PositionType.definition: Indicates whether the position is fixed (post settlement).

SafekeepingAccount.name: Safekeeping Account
SafekeepingAccount.definition: Account where financial instruments are maintained.

BlockChainAddressOrWallet.name: Block Chain Address Or Wallet
BlockChainAddressOrWallet.definition: Blockchain address or wallet where digital assets are maintained. This is the equivalent of safekeeping account for digital assets.

ClientSecuritiesMovementIdentification.name: Client Securities Movement Identification
ClientSecuritiesMovementIdentification.definition: Reference assigned by the party A to the financial instrument movement.

TripartyAgentServiceProviderSecuritiesMo.name: Triparty Agent Service Provider Securities Movement Identification
TripartyAgentServiceProviderSecuritiesMo.definition: Reference assigned by the triparty-agent/service-provider to the financial instrument movement.

SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress1Ru.definition: If SafekeepingAccount is present, BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be absent.

SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress2Ru.definition: If BlockChainAddressOrWallet is present, SafekeepingAccount must be absent.
